text.p: Vacation Break U.S.A. Inc said Thursday it had agreed to a resolution of allegations that the company improperly marketed its low-cost Florida and Bahamas vacation packages.
The company said it consented, without any admission of wrongdoing or liability, to entry of a final judgment by the Consumer Protection Division of the Office of the Attorney General of Maryland.
The comapny said the marketing program in question was discontinued over a year ago.

As part of the settlement, Vacation Break agreed to fully inform eligible consumers of details of the low-cost vacation package, to provide refunds to consumers who previously requested refunds, and, during the next six months, to arbitrate claims of certain Maryland consumers who meet an established criteria.
Additionally, the company agreed to pay a $25,000 penalty to the state.
